His father drove an autorickshaw. His mother worked the fields. At 21, he became one of India's youngest IAS officers.

Ansar Shaikh was born in Shelgaon village, Jalna district, in Maharashtra's Marathwada region, to a father who drove an autorickshaw and a mother who worked as an agricultural laborer. He scored 91% in his Class 10 boards, then graduated in Political Science from Fergusson College, Pune. In 2016, at age 21, he cleared the UPSC Civil Services Examination on his first attempt with All India Rank 361, becoming one of India's youngest IAS officers. He was allotted the West Bengal cadre and has since served as Additional District Magistrate of Malda.
